description: Records your shop’s confirmation of the exact part and dimensions you stock, so designers can build parts around it. Only confirm a part you have checked: designs are cut to these numbers. Give evidence: a datasheet link or how you measured it. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

depth_mm.description: Same as width for a round or hexagonal part

evidence.description: The datasheet lines, or how and with what it was measured

width_mm.description: Diameter for a round part, across flats for a hexagonal part

name: confirm_hardware_dimensions
title: Confirm a part’s exact dimensions
